cancellationPolicy: Booking fees are nonrefundable after the booking date.
On the booking date by 23:59, within the cancellation window | None
Within 7 days of booking, with at least 10 days until the event | None
From 8 days after booking through 10 days before the event | KRW {fee} per ticket
9 to 7 days before the event | 10% of the ticket amount
6 to 3 days before the event | 20% of the ticket amount
2 to 1 day before the event | 30% of the ticket amount

Booking fees are also refunded for eligible cancellations on the booking date. Starting the next day, the fees based on the event date take priority if the event is within 9 days, even if you booked within the last 7 days.
Standard cancellations close at 23:59 the day before the event.
The ticket amount includes paid add-ons for that ticket. Booking fees are excluded from the cancellation fee calculation.
If the flat fee equals or exceeds the ticket amount, the refund is zero and there is no additional charge. Existing bookings follow the terms shown when you booked.

analyticsProcessing.title: Privacy notice for optional individual visitor analytics
analyticsProcessing.version: Notice analytics-v2-replay · Published November 12, 2026. This new optional feature applies from the time you consent to collection/use and international transfers. Earlier visits and marketing-message consent are not reused retroactively. Read this together with the main service privacy policy.
analyticsProcessing.purposes: To understand campaign arrivals and friction in signup and booking, we collect random browser/session IDs; consent version, time and choices; normalized public paths, referrer domains and UTM labels; device/browser/OS/language; visits, click/touch positions and target categories, screen/document sizes, scrolling and engagement times. Verified sign-ins link the member ID, allowing authorized administrators to view visits alongside the existing account name and email. Masked page-structure changes, pointer movements and scrolling support session replay. This first-party analytics data is not sent to advertising platforms or combined with external ad profiles. Google interest analytics follows the separate optional choices below.
analyticsProcessing.retentionActivity: Activity, sessions and account links: 90 days. Replay: 14 days. Expired data is excluded from access and removed by scheduled cleanup.
analyticsProcessing.retentionTotals: Statistics without identifiers: 1 year. Temporary activity signal: 5 minutes. Withdrawal-blocking hash and pending deletion request: up to 90 days.
analyticsProcessing.retentionBrowser: Browser choice and visitor ID: up to 90 days. Tab session: expires after 30 minutes of inactivity. Input values and screen text are masked; passwords, payment/QR data and search text are not recorded.
analyticsProcessing.transferTitle: Processing and separate optional international-transfer consent
analyticsProcessing.countriesBody: The primary API, database and new automated backups are in Seoul, South Korea. Provider maintenance and limited authorized support access may take place in the countries below. This does not mean all data is copied to every country.
analyticsProcessing.dataBody: Server processing, storage, delivery, backup and maintenance of the optional analytics data described above. Raw analytics records are not routinely shared in support cases.
analyticsProcessing.timingBody: After both optional consents, data is sent directly to the Seoul API over encrypted HTTPS during use. Personal analytics/replay payloads and administrator detail responses do not pass through Cloudflare CDN. Provider maintenance may involve authorized access when necessary.
analyticsProcessing.retentionBody: Active analytics storage follows the 90/14-day limits above. Database backups retain the latest 7 copies; recovery logs retain 7 days. Withdrawals and expiry are reapplied before restored data is used. Final deletion in provider systems may take up to 180 days after deletion instructions under Google terms; these copies are not reused for analytics.
analyticsProcessing.withdrawalBody: Declining either item or choosing Decline analytics here disables optional analytics, without affecting signup, login or booking. Withdrawal stops collection and requests deletion of this browser’s activity, replay and account links. Failed requests are retried and are not shown as completed.
analyticsProcessing.accessLogs: Existing communications and access logs needed to serve and secure the site are separate. Cloudflare continues to deliver ordinary site traffic; this choice neither newly authorizes nor stops all existing processing. Optional analytics request telemetry and payloads are excluded from Sentry and the corresponding Cloud Logging request-log storage.
analyticsProcessing.contact: Requests/contact: privacy@heygrabit.com. Records from other devices can be requested after identity verification. For the privacy officer and general processing, see the

analyticsChoices.choose: Choose each item separately. Individual analytics and masked session recordings start only after both choices are accepted. Declining does not affect signup or booking.
analyticsChoices.collect: [Optional] I agree to collection and use for account-linked visits, click/touch coordinates, scrolling and masked session replay. Activity is retained for 90 days and replay for 14 days.
analyticsChoices.transfer: [Optional] I separately agree to international transfers for optional analytics, after reviewing the Google Cloud countries, recipients, purposes, retention and transfer methods above.

usageCounts.title: Usage counts without visitor identifiers
usageCounts.summary: From November 12, 2026, we total public screen categories and page displays, signup/booking/checkout starts, seat-selection actions, link clicks, 75% scrolls and 30-second displays by hour to improve the service. These counters store no visitor, session or member IDs, full URLs, form contents, referrals or device information. We retain no individual event history, do not identify people or journeys, and do not send these counts to advertising platforms. Totals are retained for up to 365 days.
usageCounts.choices: We respect browser privacy signals and the setting below. Turning counts off does not affect signup, sign-in or booking. Only an on/off preference is stored until you change it or clear site data. Existing security and service access logs are handled separately under the Privacy Policy.

privacyNotices.virtualTitle: Virtual account payments and refund bank details
privacyNotices.virtualIssue: When you choose a virtual account, Grabit receives the deposit bank, virtual account number, deadline and payment status from Toss Payments. Grabit shows these details in your booking and issues your ticket when the deposit is confirmed.
privacyNotices.virtualRefund: Grabit stores the refund bank, account number and account holder name you enter at checkout in encrypted form and sends these details to Toss Payments to process a refund. If you prefer not to provide a refund account, you can choose another payment method offered for the event. Article 3 below describes how long payment records are retained.

googleAnalytics.title: Google interest analytics · separate optional feature
googleAnalytics.purpose: We use Google Analytics interest reporting with Google signals. With your separate consent, first-party analytics cookies on Grabit (such as _ga) and Google third-party advertising cookies/identifiers may be used together to produce aggregate interests. We do not identify individuals in Google aggregate reports or join them to member preference answers.
googleAnalytics.recipient: Recipient: Google LLC (1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA). Purpose: public-page visits, campaign performance and aggregate interest analysis. Only after consent, Google cookies/browser identifiers, device/browser information, public paths and sanitised acquisition information are sent over HTTPS. Google derives approximate location from IP and may associate activity with consenting signed-in users who enabled ads personalisation. Grabit member IDs, contact details, preference answers and payment records are not sent.
googleAnalytics.locations: This covers Google’s published data-centre locations and Google Analytics subprocessors’ service-operation/support locations. Actual storage/support routes may vary; this does not mean every visit is copied to every country. Data is sent over HTTPS on public-page visits after both consents.
googleAnalytics.retention: Your choice is stored for up to 90 days; Google analytics cookies expire after 60 days without automatic renewal. GA user/event and Google signals data use a 2-month retention setting with monthly expiry deletion. This setting does not apply to standard aggregated reports. Final deletion from Google systems may take up to 180 days after deletion instructions under its processing terms.
googleAnalytics.withdrawal: Both consents are optional; declining does not affect signup or booking. Withdrawal stops future transmission and clears Google analytics cookies in this browser. It does not immediately erase Google’s existing aggregate reports. Further requests: privacy@heygrabit.com.

entryGuide.title: Ticket and entry guide
entryGuide.intro: Please read the following information before attending the show.
entryGuide.mobile: Admission uses mobile QR tickets. No paper ticket is issued. Show your QR code at the entrance.
entryGuide.trading: The parties to an unauthorized transaction bear any resulting loss. The organizer and ticketing service cannot accept responsibility or resolve such disputes.
entryGuide.personal: Keep your booking information private. The organizer and ticketing service are not responsible if negligence exposes your personal information or lets someone else use it for verification.
entryGuide.transfer: Transferring an e-ticket QR code can result in fraud or misuse. The organizer and ticketing service cannot take responsibility for or resolve problems arising from a transfer.
entryGuide.danger: Alcohol, fireworks, lasers and other items that threaten safety are restricted. Anyone found with them may be asked to leave.
entryGuide.food: Food and drinks are prohibited except for plain water in a PET bottle of 500 mL or less.
entryGuide.obstruction: Large cameras, tablets and other items that obstruct the view or disturb others are restricted from entry and use.
entryGuide.photos: Photos and videos are permitted during the show. Disrupting others with a large tripod or other bulky equipment may result in removal without warning.
entryGuide.copyright: Live streaming and other copyright infringements are strictly prohibited.
entryGuide.conduct: Abuse, loud disruptive behavior or intoxication that disturbs other attendees may result in removal without a refund.
entryGuide.emergency: In an emergency, evacuate promptly as directed by venue staff.
entryGuide.view: Your seat position, differences in height, structures or staging may limit visibility. Refunds and seat changes for these reasons may be unavailable.
entryGuide.valuables: Look after your valuables. The organizer is not responsible for loss or theft resulting from personal negligence.
